document: closing procedure for the two remaining goal items
purpose: Written in advance so the steps are deterministic rather than improvised when the profile ends. The ledger already states the exact condition for item 5, and this makes the rest explicit.

item5_stress24h.currentlyMissing: zero such files, which is correct while the profile is still running
item5_stress24h.decisionRule: The ledger already says it stays NOT_RUN until a 24h run reports passed=true with durationMet=true. That is the rule: read the report rather than infer, and set PASS only if both fields are true.
item5_stress24h.ifPassed: Set the entry to PASS, fill finishedUtc, and record observedSeconds, requestedSeconds, completedChunks, refills and peak heap from the report.
item5_stress24h.ifFailed: Leave it NOT_RUN and record the failure verbatim, including the failure field. Nothing is smoothed over.
item5_stress24h.eitherWay: Copy stress-report.json into docs/evidence/ before anything else touches build/, because a later build or clean removes it.

item2_gameTest.independentCheck: Compare that count against the inventory recorded before the run: 129 methods across 34 classes. The two figures come from different sources, so agreement is a check rather than a restatement.
item2_gameTest.evidence: build/reports/gametest/results.xml, which is rebuilt each run - copy it to docs/evidence/ as well.
item2_gameTest.budget: About 3.65 hours, with no gradle timeout and an 8 GB default heap.

Update the six-item table in the report with the item 2 and item 5 results
Refresh docs/evidence/INDEX-20261007.json once no further files will be added
Distinguish clearly what automation proved from the nine real-machine items, which do not change

s5ReleaseExpectation.expectedOutcome: The script will throw, because verifyReleaseArtifacts throws on the version string and the script treats a non-zero exit as failure.
s5ReleaseExpectation.thisIsCorrect: The gate is refusing to sign a preview. The ledger already records this under version-lock and full-package.
s5ReleaseExpectation.readThisInsteadOfExitStatus: execution.json in the evidence directory: remapJarShaMatch is the reproducibility answer, and passed false is the version gate.
s5ReleaseExpectation.stillWorthRunning: Yes. Both builds run with the offline and strict flags, which re-exercises the offline path at current source and dates that item, and the SHA comparison is a genuine reproducibility result.

orderedSteps: 1. Confirm the profile ended and stress-report.json exists under the run's stress-reports directory
2. Copy into docs/evidence/: stress-report.json, the whole samples directory, header.json, and build/s5-stress-24h2.log
3. Run gradlew runGameTest, then copy build/reports/gametest/results.xml into docs/evidence/
4. Only now run Test-S5Release.ps1 - its first gradle argument is clean, twice, which deletes build/ entirely
5. Read execution.json rather than the exit status, since the version gate makes it throw
6. Update the six-item table, the acceptance ledger and the evidence index
verifyBeforeRunningS5Release: Confirm the step 2 and 3 copies are present in docs/evidence/. If they are not, stop: that script's clean removes build/run/serverSmoke/vanilla/<runId>/ and build/s5-stress-24h2.log, and nothing else will regenerate them.

roundBudgetConstraint.measured: 6.5 minutes per round, measured between rounds 119 and 131
roundBudgetConstraint.correctedPosition: Re-measured at 11.62 hours remaining with 167 rounds left: 108 rounds for the profile plus about 10 for the post-profile steps is 118 needed against 167 available, leaving 49 rounds of slack.
roundBudgetConstraint.correctionNote: An earlier version of this note claimed a 10-round shortfall. That was arithmetic error - it charged the post-profile wall clock against the round budget as well as the fixed round cost. The operational guidance below is unchanged because it is what makes the post-profile work cost 10 rounds rather than 55.
therefore: Start the post-profile steps as background jobs in the round the profile ends, not in a later one
Do not spend a round waiting for a long task; start it and collect it in a subsequent round
Keep each round to one substantive action rather than several
roundBudgetConstraint.theShapeThatFits: Round A starts runGameTest as a background job. Round B collects it and starts Test-S5Release the same way. Round C collects that and writes the closing summary.

exactCommands.step2CopyEvidence: Copy stress-report.json, the samples directory and header.json from build/run/serverSmoke/vanilla/s5stress24h20261007084723/build/stress-reports/run-1791334079847/ into docs/evidence/, plus build/s5-stress-24h2.log
exactCommands.step3GameTest: gradlew runGameTest --no-daemon --console=plain, then copy build/reports/gametest/results.xml into docs/evidence/
exactCommands.warningAboutStep5: The root must include serverSmoke\vanilla. A path like build\run\s5stress24h20261007084723 passes the script's guard but has no stress-reports directory beneath it, so the script would report passed=false with a message about no report being found - a fail-closed outcome that would nonetheless look like a profile failure.
exactCommands.warningAboutStep4: Test-S5Release throws by design because the version gate fails; read execution.json for remapJarShaMatch rather than the exit status.
